mapper.select: SELECT repair_idx, repair_date, equip_name, worker_name, symptom, repair_content, reg_user, reg_date FROM tb_repair_history WHERE repair_date BETWEEN #{sdateTime} AND #{edateTime} ORDER BY repair_date DESC, repair_idx DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_repair_history (repair_date, equip_name, worker_name, symptom, repair_content, reg_user) VALUES (#{repair_date}, #{equip_name}, #{worker_name}, #{symptom}, #{repair_content}, #{reg_user})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_repair_history SET repair_date = #{repair_date}, equip_name = #{equip_name}, worker_name = #{worker_name}, symptom = #{symptom}, repair_content = #{repair_content} WHERE repair_idx = #{repair_idx}
